description: High Sorcerer Andromath wishes to speak with you, <name>.  He is at the top of the wizard's sanctum, in the mage's district of Stormwind.
It would be wise to speak with him, for Andromath is one of the most powerful mages not locked away in Dalaran.  Council with him is high council indeed.
completion: Greetings, <name>. I am pleased to see you, and hope you have time to listen to an old man's words...
